entries.name: Acid Pool
entries.warning: You smell a biting, vinegar-like stench rising from beneath the floor seams.
entries.description: A false tile tilts into a hidden stone cistern brimming with corrosive vitriol.
entries.revealed_description: A false tile tilts into a hidden stone cistern brimming with corrosive vitriol.
entries.countermeasure: Test flagstones with a ten-foot pole or skirt the wall edges.

entries.name: Sonic Alarm
entries.warning: A high-pitched metallic click rings out, followed by a vibrating hum.
entries.description: A trip-string triggers a resonant bronze bell hidden in an acoustic chimney, alerting nearby denizens.
entries.revealed_description: A trip-string triggers a resonant bronze bell hidden in an acoustic chimney, alerting nearby denizens.
entries.countermeasure: Sever the trip-wire with shears while bracing the striker mechanism.

entries.name: Slick Grease Reservoir
entries.warning: A faint sheen glazes the stones ahead, smelling of animal lard and grease.
entries.description: Pressure releases pressurized oil nozzles, turning the sloped flagstones into a frictionless slide toward danger.
entries.revealed_description: Pressure releases pressurized oil nozzles, turning the sloped flagstones into a frictionless slide toward danger.
entries.countermeasure: Spread sand or torches to burn away the lubricant before treading.

entries.name: Swinging Scythe Blade
entries.warning: You hear a metallic latch slip free overhead.
entries.description: A heavy curved steel blade sweeps down from a narrow ceiling slot in a lethal pendulum arc.
entries.revealed_description: A heavy curved steel blade sweeps down from a narrow ceiling slot in a lethal pendulum arc.
entries.countermeasure: Duck low and wedge iron spikes into the ceiling slot to jam the pivot.

entries.name: Iron Drop Cage
entries.warning: Rusted iron chains rattle sharply above.
entries.description: A heavy square portcullis cage plunges from the rafters, trapping anyone beneath its iron bars.
entries.revealed_description: A heavy square portcullis cage plunges from the rafters, trapping anyone beneath its iron bars.
entries.countermeasure: Lever the bottom bars with a crowbar or locate the counterweight release.

entries.name: Scattered Caltrops
entries.warning: A metallic skittering sound bounces across the stone floor.
entries.description: Spring-loaded dispensers in the baseboards fling four-pointed steel caltrops across all escape routes.
entries.revealed_description: Spring-loaded dispensers in the baseboards fling four-pointed steel caltrops across all escape routes.
entries.countermeasure: Sweep the passage carefully with a broom or wooden shield.

entries.name: Whirring Circular Saw
entries.warning: A dull grinding whir begins inside the wall masonry.
entries.description: A water- or weight-driven circular steel saw blade thrusts horizontally along a floor-level groove.
entries.revealed_description: A water- or weight-driven circular steel saw blade thrusts horizontally along a floor-level groove.
entries.countermeasure: Jam an iron crowbar into the track to break the drive teeth.

entries.name: Mounted Crossbow Volley
entries.warning: The unmistakable sound of multiple dry wooden bows snapping taut.
entries.description: Concealed heavy crossbows mounted in embrasures fire armor-piercing iron quarrels down the hallway.
entries.revealed_description: Concealed heavy crossbows mounted in embrasures fire armor-piercing iron quarrels down the hallway.
entries.countermeasure: Hold heavy shields forward and advance along the blind angle.

entries.name: Crushed Glass Trench
entries.warning: A faint crunching sound echoes under your boots.
entries.description: A concealed false depression is filled with jagged, calcified and obsidian glass shards that shred footwear.
entries.revealed_description: A concealed false depression is filled with jagged, calcified and obsidian glass shards that shred footwear.
entries.countermeasure: Cover the trench with wooden planks or shield mantlets.

entries.name: Crushing Ceiling
entries.warning: Dust showers down as massive counterweights begin to grind overhead.
entries.description: The heavy stone ceiling slab slowly descends with crushing force, grinding anything beneath into dust.
entries.revealed_description: The heavy stone ceiling slab slowly descends with crushing force, grinding anything beneath into dust.
entries.countermeasure: Place sturdy iron pitons or stone blocks under the descent notches.

entries.name: Crushing Walls
entries.warning: The opposing side walls let out a deep stone-on-stone groan as they shift inward.
entries.description: Massive stone wall blocks grind slowly toward the center of the corridor to crush intruders.
entries.revealed_description: Massive stone wall blocks grind slowly toward the center of the corridor to crush intruders.
entries.countermeasure: Sprint to the safety alcove or wedge an iron crowbar into the gearing.

entries.name: Concealed Dart Launchers
entries.warning: A rapid chorus of soft puffs whispers from the walls.
entries.description: Dozens of tiny brass nozzles embedded in the mortared stone spit needle-sharp poisoned darts.
entries.revealed_description: Dozens of tiny brass nozzles embedded in the mortared stone spit needle-sharp poisoned darts.
entries.countermeasure: Drop flat to the floor beneath the firing plane.

entries.name: Lightning Capacitor Arc
entries.warning: The hairs on your arms stand on end and the air crackles with static.
entries.description: Copper-inlaid ley runes discharge a blinding jolt of stored elemental electricity across the room.
entries.revealed_description: Copper-inlaid ley runes discharge a blinding jolt of stored elemental electricity across the room.
entries.countermeasure: Ground the connection using a wooden pole or leather-wrapped bar.

entries.name: Electrified Metal Grid
entries.warning: A faint blue spark dances across the iron flagstones.
entries.description: An iron floor grating is linked to a galvanic generator, shocking anyone stepping upon it without rubber/leather soles.
entries.revealed_description: An iron floor grating is linked to a galvanic generator, shocking anyone stepping upon it without rubber/leather soles.
entries.countermeasure: Lay dry wooden planks or thick canvas bedrolls across the grating.

entries.name: Tilting Floor Elevator
entries.warning: The stone platform tilts downward with a stomach-dropping groan.
entries.description: The entire floor section serves as a counterweighted hoist that plunges into a subterranean pit when stepped on.
entries.revealed_description: The entire floor section serves as a counterweighted hoist that plunges into a subterranean pit when stepped on.
entries.trigger: Weight exceeding 100 lbs on center plate
entries.countermeasure: Leap back toward the threshold or secure a safety rope to the doorframe.

entries.name: Frost Rune Freezer
entries.warning: A blast of sub-zero wind frostbites your exposed skin in an instant.
entries.description: An arcane cryogenic sigil detonates, dropping the room temperature below freezing and coating everything in rime.
entries.revealed_description: An arcane cryogenic sigil detonates, dropping the room temperature below freezing and coating everything in rime.
entries.countermeasure: Scratch away the outer containment circle of the rune with a dagger.

entries.name: Chamber Filling With Sand
entries.warning: A rush of dry grit pours from ceiling grates like an enormous hourglass.
entries.description: Overhead silos release thousands of pounds of dry desert sand, threatening to bury everyone alive.
entries.revealed_description: Overhead silos release thousands of pounds of dry desert sand, threatening to bury everyone alive.
entries.trigger: Lifting an item from a pedestal
entries.countermeasure: Wedge the ceiling discharge grates or climb atop the rising sand heap.

entries.name: Flooding Sluice Chamber
entries.warning: The roar of rushing torrents booms behind the walls.
entries.description: Heavy iron floodgates open from an underground reservoir, rapidly submerging the room in freezing murky water.
entries.revealed_description: Heavy iron floodgates open from an underground reservoir, rapidly submerging the room in freezing murky water.
entries.countermeasure: Locate the emergency drainage lever usually situated near the ceiling arch.

entries.name: Flame Jet Emitters
entries.warning: The scent of lamp oil and sulfur precedes a bright pilot flame.
entries.description: Concealed copper siphon tubes engulf the corridor in a roaring cone of pressurized liquid fire.
entries.revealed_description: Concealed copper siphon tubes engulf the corridor in a roaring cone of pressurized liquid fire.
entries.countermeasure: Roll away from the nozzle path and seal the aperture with mud or wet cloaks.

entries.name: Flammable Gas Reservoir
entries.warning: A sweet, rotten-egg odor seeps through the cracks in the floor.
entries.description: Volatile marsh gas is released into the room; any open torch or spark threatens a devastating deflagration.
entries.revealed_description: Volatile marsh gas is released into the room; any open torch or spark threatens a devastating deflagration.
entries.countermeasure: Extinguish all open flames immediately and vent the corridor.

entries.name: Blinding Flash Prism
entries.warning: A sharp mirror glint blinds your peripheral vision.
entries.description: A magical magnesium prism flashes with dazzling radiance, stunning and blinding anyone looking toward it.
entries.revealed_description: A magical magnesium prism flashes with dazzling radiance, stunning and blinding anyone looking toward it.
entries.countermeasure: Shield eyes with an arm or look away into dark corners.

entries.name: Sleeping Gas Spouts
entries.warning: A sweet-smelling purple vapor drifts lazily from the skirting boards.
entries.description: Potent soporific vapors flood the lower air, causing eyelids to droop and limbs to grow heavy.
entries.revealed_description: Potent soporific vapors flood the lower air, causing eyelids to droop and limbs to grow heavy.
entries.countermeasure: Hold wet cloth over nose and mouth and crawl into higher air.

entries.name: Illusory Flagstone Floor
entries.warning: Your foot encounters empty air where solid stone appeared to be.
entries.description: A permanent phantasm depicts a smooth stone floor over a yawning forty-foot deep chasm.
entries.revealed_description: A permanent phantasm depicts a smooth stone floor over a yawning forty-foot deep chasm.
entries.countermeasure: Probe ahead with a staff or throw pebbles to reveal the true chasm edge.

entries.name: Overhead Rockfall Chute
entries.warning: A deep subterranean rumbling shakes the ceiling arch.
entries.description: Weakened ceiling timbers give way, dumping a ton of jagged quarry rocks onto the passage below.
entries.revealed_description: Weakened ceiling timbers give way, dumping a ton of jagged quarry rocks onto the passage below.
entries.countermeasure: Leap forward into the door frame where the ceiling is solidly vaulted.

entries.name: Snare Hoist Trap
entries.warning: A cord catches tight around your ankle and whips upward.
entries.description: A counterweighted hemp noose yanks the victim upside down toward the ceiling beams.
entries.revealed_description: A counterweighted hemp noose yanks the victim upside down toward the ceiling beams.
entries.countermeasure: Cut the hoist line while bracing against the nearby wall.

entries.name: Lava Sluice Channel
entries.warning: Intense, blistering heat radiates from a rusted wall grate.
entries.description: A molten slag gate cracks open, releasing a glowing stream of liquid fire across the floor.
entries.revealed_description: A molten slag gate cracks open, releasing a glowing stream of liquid fire across the floor.
entries.countermeasure: Scramble onto elevated ledges and close the sluice baffle.

entries.name: Lurking Magma Fissure
entries.warning: The floor flags are uncomfortably warm and hairline cracks glow red.
entries.description: Fragile pumice crust covers an active pocket of subterranean molten magma.
entries.revealed_description: Fragile pumice crust covers an active pocket of subterranean molten magma.
entries.countermeasure: Step only on black basalt anchor ridges around the chamber perimeter.

entries.name: Necrotic Hex Rune
entries.warning: A chilling, discordant hum vibrates directly inside your skull.
entries.description: A desecrated ward pulses with black necrotic energy, sapping vitality and withering flesh.
entries.revealed_description: A desecrated ward pulses with black necrotic energy, sapping vitality and withering flesh.
entries.countermeasure: Disrupt the runic salt border or cover the glyph with a lead shield.

entries.name: Chilling Mist Dispenser
entries.warning: A thick, freezing fog creeps across the floor, numbing toes and boots.
entries.description: Perforated copper pipes emit a freezing chemical mist that obscures vision and causes hypothermia.
entries.revealed_description: Perforated copper pipes emit a freezing chemical mist that obscures vision and causes hypothermia.
entries.countermeasure: Disengage the valve behind the corner stone or burn through the fog.

entries.name: Heavy Steam Piston
entries.warning: A hiss of pressurized steam blasts through a release valve.
entries.description: A massive iron piston punches outward from the wall at chest height, knocking victims across the room.
entries.revealed_description: A massive iron piston punches outward from the wall at chest height, knocking victims across the room.
entries.countermeasure: Time the piston recoil cycle or block the exhaust vent with an iron spike.

entries.name: Concealed Pit Trap
entries.warning: The stone beneath your foot tilts freely on a central axis.
entries.description: A balanced counterweight pit cover pivots open, dropping victims into a 20-foot excavated pit.
entries.revealed_description: A balanced counterweight pit cover pivots open, dropping victims into a 20-foot excavated pit.
entries.trigger: Stepping on the pivot side of the trapdoor
entries.countermeasure: Leap across or test edges to find the stationary outer frame.

entries.name: Envenomed Caltrop Carpet
entries.warning: A subtle green sheen glints across small jagged points on the floor.
entries.description: Iron caltrops coated in virulent spider venom line the floor of the darkened entryway.
entries.revealed_description: Iron caltrops coated in virulent spider venom line the floor of the darkened entryway.
entries.countermeasure: Sweep aside with a wide wooden shield before proceeding.

entries.name: Iron Portcullis Deadfall
entries.warning: A loud clang of iron teeth echoes from the corridor ceiling.
entries.description: A spiked iron portcullis drops like a guillotine, sealing the exit and threatening anyone beneath.
entries.revealed_description: A spiked iron portcullis drops like a guillotine, sealing the exit and threatening anyone beneath.
entries.countermeasure: Insert an iron prybar or heavy timber to block the downward drop.

entries.name: Murder Hole Arrow Slits
entries.warning: Shadows flicker behind narrow slits in the upper masonry.
entries.description: Mechanical arrow volley traps shoot through narrow slits angled down the killing corridor.
entries.revealed_description: Mechanical arrow volley traps shoot through narrow slits angled down the killing corridor.
entries.countermeasure: Advance with shields raised overhead or smoke out the firing chambers.

entries.name: Quicksand Sand-Vat
entries.warning: The dry floor suddenly gives way like liquid silt beneath you.
entries.description: A deep cistern filled with liquefied fine silt pulls victims down like quicksand.
entries.revealed_description: A deep cistern filled with liquefied fine silt pulls victims down like quicksand.
entries.trigger: Stepping onto the deceptive sand crust
entries.countermeasure: Do not thrash; spread weight out flat and throw a rope or pole.

entries.name: Battering Ram Swing
entries.warning: The creak of a heavy counterweight swinging overhead.
entries.description: A massive bronze-tipped oak beam swings outward from a hidden wall recess like a pendulum.
entries.revealed_description: A massive bronze-tipped oak beam swings outward from a hidden wall recess like a pendulum.
entries.trigger: Opening a false chest or door
entries.countermeasure: Drop to the floor; the ram sweeps three feet above the ground.

entries.name: Rolling Boulder Chute
entries.warning: A deafening roar of rolling granite vibrates through your teeth.
entries.description: A massive five-ton spherical granite boulder rolls down the sloped corridor behind the party.
entries.revealed_description: A massive five-ton spherical granite boulder rolls down the sloped corridor behind the party.
entries.trigger: Tripping a floor latch on the slope
entries.countermeasure: Sprint to a side alcove or dive into a floor depression.

entries.name: Greased Frictionless Chute
entries.warning: The stone floor tilts steeply downward into darkness.
entries.description: The flagstones pivot at a 45-degree angle, dropping into a slick grease chute ending in iron spikes.
entries.revealed_description: The flagstones pivot at a 45-degree angle, dropping into a slick grease chute ending in iron spikes.
entries.countermeasure: Drive iron spikes into the wall mortar to secure a handhold.

entries.name: Spiked Pitfall
entries.warning: A brittle snapping of concealed willow branches underfoot.
entries.description: A false plaster floor gives way, dumping victims onto upward-pointing fire-hardened wooden spikes.
entries.revealed_description: A false plaster floor gives way, dumping victims onto upward-pointing fire-hardened wooden spikes.
entries.trigger: Stepping on the weakened plaster cover
entries.countermeasure: Check for plaster seams with a pole before crossing.

entries.name: Vitriol Spray Nozzle
entries.warning: A wet hiss sprays a cloud of stinging droplets.
entries.description: Concealed copper gargoyles spray concentrated acid that eats through cloth, leather, and flesh.
entries.revealed_description: Concealed copper gargoyles spray concentrated acid that eats through cloth, leather, and flesh.
entries.trigger: Tampering with a lock or chest
entries.countermeasure: Douse immediately with water or neutralize with sand/chalk.

entries.name: Pitch & Tar Floor
entries.warning: Your boots stick stubbornly to the floor with a sticky sucking sound.
entries.description: A thick layer of black petroleum pitch coats the floor, holding victims fast while oil lamps overhead flare.
entries.revealed_description: A thick layer of black petroleum pitch coats the floor, holding victims fast while oil lamps overhead flare.
entries.countermeasure: Lay cloaks or wooden shields over the tar to step across.

entries.name: Whiplash Thorn Branch
entries.warning: The sound of bent wood releasing with tremendous velocity.
entries.description: A spring-tensioned thorn branch studded with iron barb tips whips across the trail at chest height.
entries.revealed_description: A spring-tensioned thorn branch studded with iron barb tips whips across the trail at chest height.
entries.trigger: Snapping a low vine or cord
entries.countermeasure: Crouch low; the whip arc passes overhead.

entries.name: Taut Wire Garrote
entries.warning: A glint of polished piano wire at neck height.
entries.description: A steel razor-wire is stretched taut across a dark doorway at neck height.
entries.revealed_description: A steel razor-wire is stretched taut across a dark doorway at neck height.
entries.countermeasure: Hold torch or lantern at eye level to spot the silver wire glint.

entries.name: Concealed Trapdoor into Darkness
entries.warning: The wooden floorboards give way underfoot with a hollow snap.
entries.description: A hinged trapdoor drops open, plunging victims into an ancient dry well shaft.
entries.revealed_description: A hinged trapdoor drops open, plunging victims into an ancient dry well shaft.
entries.countermeasure: Walk along the joists and wall perimeters.

entries.name: Spiked Trapdoor
entries.warning: A sudden drop followed by the glint of iron spikes below.
entries.description: A trapdoor opens above a 15-foot pit bristling with rusty iron stakes.
entries.revealed_description: A trapdoor opens above a 15-foot pit bristling with rusty iron stakes.
entries.countermeasure: Rig a safety rope between companions before navigating unknown hallways.

entries.name: Chamber Descent Trapdoor
entries.warning: The floor drops away into a lower dungeon tier.
entries.description: A large trapdoor drops the party straight into the monster-infested level below.
entries.revealed_description: A large trapdoor drops the party straight into the monster-infested level below.
entries.trigger: Weight of two or more travelers
entries.countermeasure: Anchor to a rear piton and cross one at a time.

entries.name: Airtight Vacuum Chamber
entries.warning: Heavy stone slabs seal both doorways with an airtight hiss.
entries.description: Pneumatic valves exhaust all air from the sealed chamber within minutes.
entries.revealed_description: Pneumatic valves exhaust all air from the sealed chamber within minutes.
entries.countermeasure: Wedge the doors open with iron spikes before entering completely.

entries.name: Gale-Force Wind Tunnel
entries.warning: A deafening rush of air tears cloaks and snuffs torches.
entries.description: Enormous bellows blast gale-force winds down the corridor, hurling adventurers backward into hazards.
entries.revealed_description: Enormous bellows blast gale-force winds down the corridor, hurling adventurers backward into hazards.
entries.countermeasure: Anchor ropes to wall rings and crawl along the floor.

entries.name: Violent Water Jet Surge
entries.warning: A deep roar of water pressure breaks through iron grates.
entries.description: A high-pressure torrent of water blasts from the wall, slamming victims into opposite stone walls.
entries.revealed_description: A high-pressure torrent of water blasts from the wall, slamming victims into opposite stone walls.
entries.countermeasure: Brace behind heavy stone pillars or shields.

entries.name: Iron Spring Wolf Trap
entries.warning: A sharp metallic snap clamped tight against the lower leg.
entries.description: A heavy serrated steel jaw trap hidden under leaves or dust snaps shut on the victim foot.
entries.revealed_description: A heavy serrated steel jaw trap hidden under leaves or dust snaps shut on the victim foot.
entries.trigger: Stepping directly onto the pan plate
entries.countermeasure: Pry open the dual steel springs using two crowbars or stout poles.
